title: Scalar multiplication in the first argument
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability distribution on $\Omega$, let $c\in\mathbb R$, and let $f,g:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. For the inner product $\langle f,g\rangle_\pi=\sum_{x\in\Omega}\pi(x)f(x)g(x)$, one has $\langle cf,g\rangle_\pi=c\langle f,g\rangle_\pi$.
